name: Shimane

flag.description: Four yellow katakana マ (ma) curled into rings and joined in a clover-like cloud, on a dark red field.
flag.symbolism: Four マ read as "shi-ma", since shi means four: a pun on Shimane. The cloud-shaped ring stands for unity and growth.

hook: Shimane's yellow clover on dark red is four マ (ma): four is "shi", so it reads "shi-ma" for Shimane.
trivia: Izumo Taisha is one of Japan's oldest and most important Shinto shrines.
The Iwami Ginzan silver mine once produced a large share of the world's silver.
